name: study-river
description: Printable A4 worksheets from any theme: kana/kanji tracing, questions with answer keys, and math incl. long division. 会話で選んだテーマを、印刷できるA4学習プリントに。

interface.shortDescription: テーマから印刷用A4プリントを作成
interface.longDescription: Create printable worksheets from conversationally authored content. Templates: kana/kanji tracing, text questions with answer keys, and checked integer arithmetic in horizontal or column (筆算) form. Requires host Python and ReportLab; no MCP or Study River API.
defaultPrompt: 好きな動物の名前で、ひらがなのなぞりプリントを作って
Make me a kanji practice sheet with 9 characters and readings.
Hazme una hoja con 8 divisiones largas y sus respuestas.
